data.name: Rifqi
data.gender_notes: Rifqi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who gives comfort, solace, and peace of mind. Derived from the Arabic root 'rafaqa', which means to console, comfort, or cradle. The name Rifqi carries the meaning “Comfort, Consolation, Peace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Rifqi usually hope their child will grow to embody comfort, consolation, peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, representing the essence of compassion, understanding, and kindness. It is a reminder of Allah's infinite mercy and love, and a call to extend that same compassion and comfort to others.
data.etymology: Rifqi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comfort, Consolation, Peace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rifqi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
